headline: Bitcoin steadies near $81.6k as liquidity hunt eases, altcoins surge
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is forming a tight range between the 80.8k support and 82.2k resistance, holding the descending channel lower trendline. The 4H shows a higher‑low bounce off the 80.5k liquidity pool, suggesting the next move hinges on a break of the 82.2k ceiling.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into momentum leaders – TIA, DUSK, AMP and RAD – driving a short‑term altcoin rally while Bitcoin remains range‑bound.
strategy_outlook: Spot traders should look for pull‑backs to ~80.8k for opportunistic buys; futures participants keep a short bias, targeting 80.5k, and only add longs on a decisive close above 82.2k.
